name: Akogare no Gachimuchi Oji-san ga Boku dake no Dosukebe Mama ni Nacchatta ❤
original_name: 憧れのガチムチおじさんがボクだけのドスケベママになっちゃった❤
source:
I have to do my best relying only on my own strength. It's always been that way.

Souichi Hoshiura, worn out from working at a toxic company, ended up recuperating in the countryside. Taking care of him is his uncle, Sisimaru Hoshiura, with whom he has been familiar since childhood.

Souichi thought he could relax and take it easy, but he can't stop dwelling on past troubles. He feels that Sisimaru's kind words are just empty niceties, and pushes his uncle away, asking to be left alone.

But! Sisimaru was ready to become a dirty mama who even took care of his dick! Despite being perplexed by the unexpected turn of events, his days are filled with intimate moments with the uncle he has always admired.

Let Uncle Mama heal your weary heart❤

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725330/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我只能靠自己的力量，尽力而为。一直都是这样。

星浦宗一因在一家有毒公司工作而疲惫不堪，最终在乡村养病。照顾他的是他从小就很熟悉的叔叔星浦西斯马鲁。

宗一以为自己可以放松下来，轻松一点，但他无法停止沉迷于过去的麻烦。他觉得西斯马鲁的好话只是空洞的好话，于是推开他的叔叔，要求让他一个人静一静。

但！西斯玛鲁已经准备好成为一个肮脏的妈妈，甚至照顾他的鸡鸡！尽管对意想不到的事件感到困惑，但他的日子里充满了与他一直崇拜的叔叔的亲密时刻。

让叔叔妈妈治愈你疲惫的心吧❤

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725330/]Steam[/url]]
